description:
Holder is a private offline vault for storing important card details securely on your iPhone.

Use it to keep credit cards, debit cards, ID cards, membership cards, loyalty cards, insurance cards, and other card information organized in one simple place.

Holder is built for people who want quick access to card details without storing sensitive information in notes, screenshots, messages, or random documents.

Your cards stay private, easy to find, and protected behind Face ID or Touch ID.

Why Holder?

Private storage with optional sync
Holder is designed to work offline. Card details are stored in Apple Keychain and can sync across your Apple devices through iCloud Keychain when available. Optional card images may be stored in iCloud Documents. On-device camera scanning never uploads images for OCR. You do not need to link a bank account or depend on an online wallet account.

Protected by iOS Keychain
Card details are stored using iOS Keychain, the secure storage system built into Apple platforms for sensitive information.

Face ID and Touch ID lock
Add biometric protection so only you can open your card vault.

Quick access when needed
Find saved card details faster when shopping online, booking travel, filling forms, managing subscriptions, or checking card information.

More than payment cards
Holder can store credit cards, debit cards, ID cards, membership cards, loyalty cards, insurance cards, and other cards you want to keep organized.

Simple by design
No bank linking. No finance dashboard. No spending analysis. Just a clean, private card keeper for the information you actually need.

Useful for:

- Credit and debit card storage
- Offline card access
- Secure card management
- ID card organization
- Membership and loyalty cards
- Travel card backup
- Private card storage
- Quick access to saved card details

Holder gives you a simple, secure way to keep important card information organized, private, and ready when you need it.
promotionalText: Add credit cards, IDs, memberships, and loyalty cards faster with private, on-device scanning, then protect them in Holder with Face ID.
